bugs.title: Heater stays ON above 22 °C because band hysteresis never turns it off
bugs.description: The control logic in lines 62-69 only turns the heater OFF when lastC > HEAT_OFF_C, but the measured violations show D9 was not LOW for 5030 ms starting at 1.79 s during a clean ramp, meaning the heater remained ON well past the 22 °C threshold. The OFF branch is reached only when the temperature exceeds 22.0 °C, yet the measured evidence shows the output never went LOW within the 600 ms grace, so the heater latched ON through the warm portion of the ramp. D9 was in the wrong state for 5030 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 1.79 s: D9 was not LOW for 5030 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

bugs.title: Frost override not honored within 600 ms on short/bouncy presses
bugs.description: The frost input is only sampled every 50 ms in the loop (lines 52-56) with no debounce or edge handling, and the measured evidence shows D9 was not LOW for 400-1400 ms while D2 was held LOW, exceeding the 600 ms grace. Because the frost check is polled rather than latched, short presses and bounce cause the heater to miss the forced-ON requirement entirely. D9 was in the wrong state for 3371 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 600 ms: D9 was not LOW for 400 ms while required (grace 600 ms).
